stem.text: Myasthenia gravis is a disease that results from the immune system failing to distinguish between self and non-self. Antibodies bind to a component of the junctions between a muscle and its nerve.

A.text: Impulses in the nerve to the affected muscle cannot be blocked.

B.text: The affected muscle cannot be repeatedly stimulated.

C.text: The affected muscle is permanently stimulated.

D.text: The nerve to the affected muscle does not carry any nerve impulses.
